items.title: BofA starts bullish Alvotech coverage on biosimilar launch cycle
items.summary: Investing.com -- BofA Securities initiated coverage of Alvotech S.A. with a “buy” rating and a $7 price objective, versus the stock’s $4.43 price as of Monday, after the FDA’s closure of its inspection of the company’s Reykjavik manufacturing facility removed a key regulatory overhang and as the biosimilar developer enters what BofA called its most meaningful launch cycle since inception.

items.title: What Do SEC Insider Trading Charges Mean For Bank Of America (BAC)?
items.summary: SEC files insider trading charges against a former senior Bank of America (NYSE:BAC) investment banker related to a merger advisory assignment. Regulators allege the ex-banker misused confidential deal information to trade and tip others ahead of a high profile transaction. The case focuses on conduct during the individual's tenure at Bank of America and raises fresh questions about controls around sensitive deal data.
